title: Analysis code for "A reproducible, interpretable multi-omics integration framework for clinical decision-making in glioma: a hypoxic-niche macrophage state with context-dependent prognostic value"
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript "A reproducible, interpretable multi-omics integration framework for clinical decision-making in glioma: a hypoxic-niche macrophage state with context-dependent prognostic value" (Frontiers in Big Data, Research Topic 78756).

The pipeline integrates public glioma single-cell, spatial and bulk transcriptomes to define TAM-IS, an immunosuppressive tumour-associated macrophage state, and to test three pre-registered hypotheses: (H1) cross-cohort reproducibility and transferability of the state, (H2) its coupling to the hypoxic/peri-necrotic niche, and (H3) its prognostic value in bulk cohorts. It covers 110,462 quality-controlled cells from three discovery scRNA-seq cohorts (GSE103224, GSE131928, GSE163120), independent single-cell validation cohorts (GSE89567, GSE70630), spatial validation (IvyGAP / GSE107559), and bulk survival, deconvolution and meta-analysis (TCGA-GBM/LGG via the cBioPortal study lgggbm_tcga_pub; CGGA mRNAseq_325 and mRNAseq_693), together with cell-cell communication (CellChat), ligand-target inference (NicheNet), regulon activity (pySCENIC/AUCell), druggability assessment and figure generation.

Contents: 46 scripts (39 Python, 4 R, 3 shell) organised by pipeline step under scripts/, with README.md (data sources, environment, run order, figure reproduction, caveats), env/requirements.txt (Python 3.11) and DATA_MANIFEST.md (input and reference-resource manifest). All paths are configurable through the GLIOMA_PROJ and GLIOMA_DATA environment variables, so a fresh clone runs without editing any source file. Raw data are not redistributed.
